# FIX BRIEF — Agent Arena evidence-mining agent (round 2, Vibe build)

## Context
You built the Delphi Agent Arena evidence-mining agent in /root/agent-arena
(run 1, mock mode, 10 Wave 1 drafts). Joint QA by Sekar (hands-on) and
Fable (plan-conformance + SDK verification) found 21 fixes. Your job:
implement ALL 21. Reference files on this host: FIX-LIST.md (the
consolidated list, authoritative) and QA-FINDINGS-2026-11-26.md (Sekar's
detailed findings). Read both before coding.

## Hard rules (same as round 1)
- Credentials ONLY from env vars (DELPHI_API_ACCESS_KEY, FIRECRAWL_API_KEY).
  Never hardcode or commit a secret.
- Mock mode when keys are missing; the full pipeline must run offline in mock.
- NO real submissions to Delphi in this build. The submit path stays
  triple-guarded (mode=live AND LIVE_SUBMIT=1 AND --live-submit); never
  call submitDraft from the pipeline, never enable live submit.
- No repo created or pushed until Sekar says.
- Do not break existing tests: npm test must stay 15/15 passing; ADD tests
  for every new gate rule you implement (item count, slot counting, note
  length, file size, freshness, domain check, phrase linter, lowercase
  addresses).
- TypeScript must stay clean (npx tsc --noEmit exit 0).

## The 21 fixes (FIX-LIST.md is authoritative; summary)
CRITICAL:
1. Build the live miner — zero-hallucination invariant: no number or URL
   enters a note unless extracted or computed from a live HTTP 200 fetch in
   the SAME run, fetched_at < 2 hours old. Phase 1: live Path B fetcher +
   Python CSV calculators for Wikipedia siteinfo, Bun GitHub releases, Go
   milestone (search by title, never hardcode the milestone ID), Node
   dist/index.json, IETF Datatracker. Phase 2 (wave-agnostic): Path A —
   official dataSources from markets.json → Python calculator → note
   template; Path C — domain-scoped Firecrawl discovery + compact TXT/PNG
   attachments — so Wave 2+ markets work without hardcoded specs. Live
   mining must REPLACE the frozen specs: specs.ts becomes a fallback/seed
   only; live runs fetch fresh data and recompute params.
2. Fix the 5 dead source URLs with verified live ones: Destatis real
   PE26_xxx press release URL (PE26_4xx.html is a 404), BK admin
   postal-voting page, SRG Wählbarometer, Electografia, FIDE match page.
   Verify each URL returns HTTP 200 with the expected content before
   using it.
3. Go milestone: find the real Go1.27.5 milestone BY TITLE via the GitHub
   API (milestone 305 is Go1.20.4), re-pull open/closed counts.
4. Wikipedia count: re-pull live from the siteinfo API (was 7,269,362 on
   26 Nov) and recompute the velocity math.
5. Gate item count: 1 + links.length + files.length <= 3 (replace the
   hardcoded 1+1+1).
6. Gate slots: use remainingOnMarket directly (it is the server-tracked
   remaining submissions, 0 when cap_reached; only in-flight claims not
   yet submitted may be subtracted when batching). Do NOT subtract
   onlineSubmissionCount or submittedCount from it.
7. Harden submitDraft: run terms/limits/entry-state/gate checks inside
   it; refuse if manifest.submittedAt is set; write submissionId +
   idempotencyKey back to the ledger/manifest (log the idempotency key
   BEFORE submitting so a timeout retry reuses it); surface
   verdict/reason/bounty/zeroPayReason/settlementUpTo; waitForSubmission
   timeout 30 minutes; stop polling when status is rejected; send the
   CSV as a File named "data.csv", not an unnamed Blob.
8. Terms acceptance flow: after the owner says yes, POST
   /v1/terms/acceptance (today the pipeline only throws and asks for a
   manual POST). Implement the accept step as a separate explicit CLI
   action (e.g. `npm run accept-terms`), never automatic inside a run.
HIGH:
9. Fix DE CPI 118.2 vs 118,4 mismatch — verify the real Oct 2026 VPI
   index from Destatis/GENESIS; extend verifySources to check the note's
   pasted figures against scraped content, not only the expect needles.
10. Add live API verification for api-json/static-html specs (Wikipedia
    siteinfo, GitHub API, Datatracker, CH CPI, IETF, Bun) — today they
    are never verified in live mode.
11. Separate mock/live ledgers (or mode-tag entries): mock "drafted"
    entries must not block live drafting or consume the per-market cap.
    Live mode must ignore mock entries entirely.
12. Gate additions: note length ≤ 8000 chars, file size ≤ 10 MB, asOf
    freshness check, prediction-market domain check, judge-manipulation
    phrase linter (ban judge-steering phrases + bookmaker URLs).
13. Freshness gate: source fetch/publication timestamp must be AFTER each
    market's resolutionCriteria cutoff timestamp.
14. Judge-proof attachments: compact CSV/TXT/PNG attachments (URL + UTC
    timestamp) + key figures at the top of the note (the judge fetches
    basic HTTP once and truncates long pages).
15. Move the online-submissions check (GET /v1/submissions?market=...) to
    BEFORE mining (today it runs after the analysis step).
MEDIUM:
16. Fix "56.8%%" typo in draft.ts: `${marketPct}%` → `${marketPct}`.
17. Fix draftsSkippedNoSpec double-count in pipeline.ts (report init
    assigns noSpecMarkets AND the loop pushes again).
18. Set a real agent identity: default X_AGENT_ID to a SIERA Labs
    identity (e.g. "siera-labs-evidence-miner") instead of "agent-arena".
19. Normalize marketAddress to lowercase in evidence-log.ts comparisons.
20. Remove the invented X-Delphi-Item-Budget header from submitter.ts.
LOW:
21. Live SDK smoke test: `npm run plan` in live mode (no writes) must
    work before any live draft/submit; document it in the README.

## Verification (do all of these before finishing)
- `npm install && npm test` (15/15 + new tests pass), `npx tsc --noEmit`
  clean.
- `npm run mock` end-to-end: drafts written, 0 gate rejects on valid
  specs, dedupe re-run writes 0 new drafts.
- Where no key is needed, verify corrected figures against LIVE public
  sources (Wikipedia siteinfo, GitHub API) and record the live values in
  the fix report.
- Write FIX-REPORT.md in /root/agent-arena: one section per fix # (what
  changed, files, test/verification evidence), plus known gaps (anything
  you could not verify without keys).

## Deliverable
Updated code in /root/agent-arena + FIX-REPORT.md. Do not submit anything
live. Do not create or push a repo.
Let me start by reading the FIX-LIST.md and QA-FINDINGS files, and exploring the repo.
I'll start by reading the reference files and exploring the repo structure.

# Consolidated Fix List — Agent Arena evidence-mining agent (26 Nov 2026)

Joint QA complete: Sekar (hands-on code + live source checks) + Fable
(plan-conformance + code-level addendum, verified vs verbatim files +
gensyn-delphi SDK). Sources: Sekar QA-FINDINGS-2026-11-26.md; Fable
findings #12–#20 (10:36 WIB); Fable Code-Level QA Addendum Bugs A–F
(10:40 WIB). Deduped and renumbered here; overlaps noted.

Verdict (both): DO NOT submit any of the 10 mock drafts. Plumbing passes;
data layer fails. Fix, re-mine live, re-QA, then submit.

## FIX — CRITICAL
1. Build the live miner (zero-hallucination invariant: no number/URL enters
   a note unless extracted/computed from a live HTTP 200 fetch in the same
   run, fetched_at < 2h). Phase 1: live Path B fetcher + Python CSV
   calculators (Wikipedia siteinfo, Bun GitHub releases, Go milestone by
   title, Node dist/index.json, IETF Datatracker). Phase 2 (wave-agnostic):
   Path A (official dataSources from markets.json → Python calculator →
   note template) + Path C (domain-scoped Firecrawl discovery + compact
   TXT/PNG attachments) so Wave 2+ markets run without hardcoded specs.
   [Sekar #1 + Fable architecture]
2. Fix the 5 dead source URLs — replace guesses with verified live URLs:
   Destatis real PE26_xxx press release, BK admin postal-voting page, SRG
   Wählbarometer, Electografia, FIDE match page. [Sekar #2]
3. Fix Go milestone: find the real Go1.27.5 milestone BY TITLE (305 is
   Go1.20.4), re-pull open/closed counts. [Sekar #3]
4. Fix Wikipedia count: re-pull live (7,269,362 as of 26 Nov 10:35 WIB),
   recompute velocity math (required net 6,138 / 438 per day, not 4,266).
   [Sekar #4]
5. Fix gate item count: `1 + links.length + files.length <= 3` — the
   hardcoded `1 + 1 + 1` never fails, so a 2-link + CSV draft (4 items)
   passes the gate then fails Delphi 400. [Fable Bug A]
6. Fix gate slot counting: use remainingOnMarket directly — it already
   nets submissions, so subtracting online + submitted counts blocks
   slots #2 and #3 falsely. [Fable Bug B — CONFIRMED by Fable 10:44 WIB
   with primary sources: gensyn-delphi-skills/reference/evidence-api.md
   defines remainingOnMarket as the server-tracked remaining submissions
   on the market (0 when cap_reached); only in-flight claims not yet
   submitted may be subtracted when batching several drafts for the same
   market.]
7. Harden submitDraft: run terms/limits/entry-state/gate checks inside it;
   refuse if manifest.submittedAt is set; write submissionId +
   idempotencyKey back to the ledger/manifest (log the key BEFORE
   submitting so a timeout retry reuses it); surface verdict/reason/
   bounty/zeroPayReason/settlementUpTo instead of discarding them;
   waitForSubmission timeout 30 min (docs) not 10 [CONFIRMED by Fable
   10:44 WIB: evidence-api.md "read the result again until it is judged,
   for at most about 30 minutes"; scripts/evidence.ts
   `Date.now() + 30 * 60_000`]; stop polling when
   status is rejected; send the CSV as File named "data.csv", not an
   unnamed Blob. [Fable Bug C + #19]
8. Terms acceptance flow: after the owner says "yes", POST
   /v1/terms/acceptance (today the pipeline only throws and asks for a
   manual POST). [Fable #12, remainder]

## FIX — HIGH
9. Fix DE CPI 118.2 vs 118,4 mismatch (verify the real Oct VPI from
   Destatis/GENESIS); extend verification to the note's pasted figures,
   not only the expect needles. [Sekar #5]
10. Add live API verification for api-json/static-html specs (Wikipedia,
    GitHub, Datatracker, CH CPI, IETF, Bun) — today they ship on trust.
    [Sekar #6]
11. Separate mock/live ledgers (or mode-tag entries): mock "drafted"
    entries currently block live drafting of the same 10 markets as
    duplicates and eat 1/3 of the per-market cap. [Sekar #12]
12. Gate additions: note length ≤ 8000, file size ≤ 10 MB, asOf freshness,
    prediction-market domain check, judge-manipulation phrase linter.
    [Fable Bug D + #20]
13. Freshness gate: source fetch/publication timestamp must be AFTER each
    market's resolutionCriteria cutoff timestamp (stale facts = $0).
    [Fable #17]
14. Judge-proof attachments: compact CSV/TXT/PNG (URL + UTC timestamp) +
    key figures at the top of the note for JS portals (judge fetches basic
    HTTP once and truncates long pages). [Fable #16]
15. Move the online-submissions check BEFORE mining (today it runs after
    the analysis step). [Fable #15, remainder]

## FIX — MEDIUM
16. Fix "56.8%%" typo in draft.ts (`${marketPct}%` → `${marketPct}`).
    [Sekar #7]
17. Fix draftsSkippedNoSpec double-count (latent; did not trigger this
    run). [Sekar #8]
18. Set a real agent identity: X_AGENT_ID = SIERA Labs identity, not the
    "agent-arena" default. [Sekar #9]
19. Normalize marketAddress to lowercase in evidence-log.ts (comparisons
    are case-sensitive today). [Fable Bug E]
20. Remove the invented X-Delphi-Item-Budget header. [Sekar #10 = Fable
    Bug F]

## FIX — LOW
21. Live SDK smoke test first: `npm run plan` in live mode (no writes)
    before any live draft/submit. [Sekar #11]

## ALREADY OK — verified, no action
- Terms checked before research in live mode (pipeline step 2). [Fable #12,
  check part]
- Limits + entry-state checked before mining. [Fable #18]
- Stance lock + dedupe in the gate (local part). [Fable #15, local part]
- submitEvidence via the SDK (not raw FormData); SDK verified to send
  links[] with brackets, map agentId/harness/model to X-Agent-* headers,
  honor Retry-After in waitForSubmission, and type EntryState.restricted.
  [Fable #13, SDK part + addendum verification]

## Next step
User picks which fixes Vibe builds. Then: Vibe fixes → Sekar + Fable
re-QA → live re-mine → first real submissions (only after QA passes).

{"command":"cat /root/agent-arena/QA-FINDINGS-2026-11-26.md","returncode":0,"stderr":"","stdout":"# QA Findings — Agent Arena evidence-mining agent (Vibe build, 26 Nov 2026)

QA by Sekar, hands-on: code read on the VPS copy, tests re-run by Sekar
(15/15 pass, typecheck exit 0), source URLs + API figures checked LIVE via
Firecrawl 26 Nov ~10:35 WIB. Fable is reviewing the same build against its
plan in the Slack thread; this file is Sekar's findings.

## What works (verified)
- Plumbing matches Fable's plan: limits → terms → markets/entry-state →
  filter/rank → dedupe → per-market cap → verifySources → analysis (Python) →
  gate → draft → ledger → feedback drafts.
- Triple guard on submit works (mode=live AND LIVE_SUBMIT=1 AND --live-submit
  AND key); tests 14–15 cover it; no code path calls submit in this build.
- Dedupe + stance lock work (re-run writes 0 drafts; evidence-log.jsonl has
  10 entries with distinct signatures).
- Gate logic sound (slots, stance lock, dedupe, links, ≥2 figures, banned
  content, 2.5pp edge, item budget, stance-direction sanity).
- mathgen.py math correct given inputs (DE CPI re-checked by hand: required
  MoM +0.365%, blended P(yes) ≈ 0.097).
- Market fixture is the real Wave 1 list (27 markets, real addresses/odds/
  cutoffs/pots/resolution criteria).
- README is honest about staleness ("fixture numbers are from 2026-11-26
  and go stale").

## Findings (severity order)

### CRITICAL
1. **No live mining exists.** All 10 specs are frozen Nov-26 snapshots
   (hardcoded figures/URLs/params in specs.ts + SCRAPE_FIXTURES in
   firecrawl/client.ts). Live mode only re-verifies the same hardcoded
   figures; it never fetches fresh numbers — no Firecrawl search, no API
   polling for path-2 trackers, no param refresh. Drafts go stale as days
   pass; Wave 2 markets have no specs at all. Fix: implement the live miner
   per the plan's 3 paths (Vibe builds it).
2. **5 source URLs are dead (verified live).** Destatis PE26_4xx.html → 404;
   BK admin postvoting URL → error page; SRG wahlbarometer, Electografia,
   FIDE match page → Firecrawl scrape returns nothing (unreachable). Live
   verifySources will reject those 5 drafts, so they never ship until the
   URLs are replaced with real ones.
3. **Go milestone number is wrong.** specs.ts uses
   api.github.com/repos/golang/go/milestones/305 — the live API returns
   title "Go1.20.4", NOT Go1.27.5. The "14 open / 87 closed" figures are
   not from the Go1.27.5 milestone. Fix: find the real Go1.27.5 milestone
   number, re-pull counts.
4. **Wikipedia count is wrong.** Spec says 7,271,234 (Nov 25 snapshot);
   live siteinfo API just returned 7,269,362 — 1,872 lower (counts only
   rise ~44/day, so the spec number cannot be right for Nov 25). Required
   net becomes 6,138 (438/day), not 4,266 (304/day). Stance (NO) still
   holds, but the figures are wrong. Fix: re-pull live, recompute.

### HIGH
5. **DE CPI figure/source mismatch.** Note says VPI Oct 2026 index 118.2;
   the spec's own source fixture says "Indexstand 118,4" (and the expect
   needle is 118,4). One of them is wrong; neither is verified against the
   real Destatis page. Deeper gap: verifySources checks expect needles,
   never the note's pasted figures — a figure typo slips through the gate.
   Fix: verify the real Oct VPI from Destatis/GENESIS, make note/fixture/
   needles agree, extend verification to the note's figures.
6. **api-json/static-html specs are never verified in live mode.**
   verifySources skips them, so CH CPI, IETF, Wikipedia, Bun drafts ship
   on trust with unverified figures. Fix: add live API checks for those
   (siteinfo, GitHub API, Datatracker).
7. **Mock/live ledger not separated (Fable's flag, verified by Sekar).**
   The mock run appended 10 "drafted" entries to the shared
   evidence-log.jsonl. In a live run, `hasSignature` matches them (status
   != "rejected") → all 10 markets skipped as duplicates; `draftedCount`
   counts them toward the per-market cap (1/3 used); `lockedStance`
   treats mock drafts as locking the stance. Fix: separate ledgers (or
   mode-tag entries and exclude mock ones in live mode) before the first
   live run — and re-mine from live data so signatures are fresh anyway.

### MEDIUM
7. **"56.8%%" typo in every note.** draft.ts: marketPct already ends with
   "%", then the template adds another "%". Fix: `${marketPct}%` →
   `${marketPct}`.
8. **draftsSkippedNoSpec double-count (latent).** pipeline.ts assigns
   noSpecMarkets at report init AND pushes again in the loop. Did not
   trigger this run (maxDrafts=10 broke the loop first) — fix before
   raising maxDrafts.
9. **Generic agent identity.** Defaults: agentId "agent-arena", harness
   "mistral-vibe", model "unknown". Set X_AGENT_ID to a SIERA Labs
   identity so results show under our name.

### LOW
10. **Invented X-Delphi-Item-Budget header** in submitter.ts — likely
    ignored by the API; verify or remove.
11. **Live SDK wiring is untested.** Mock tests cannot cover the real
    EvidenceClient calls. Before any live draft/submit, run `npm run plan`
    in live mode (no writes) as a smoke test.

## Verdict
Plumbing: PASS. Data layer: FAIL — do not submit any of the 10 drafts as-is.
The agent needs the live miner (fix 1) + corrected sources/figures (fixes
2–5) + verification coverage (fix 6), then a fresh live re-mine + re-QA
before the first submission.

You are the builder (Mistral Vibe CLI). Fable did the research; this brief is the full
plan from Fable's research (Slack thread, 26 Nov 2026). Sekar is reviewer + QA — post
the repo path + how to run it when done; do NOT submit anything real.

## Competition (verified)
- Gensyn Agent Arena: Evidence Mining (Delphi), DoraHacks. Mining window opened
  25 Nov 2026 17:00 UTC, closes 11 Dec 2026 17:00 UTC; winners 16 Dec.
- $7,250 USDC pool (1st $3,000 / 2nd $2,000 / 3rd $1,000 / 5x $250 feedback bounties)
  PLUS per-evidence USDC rewards (judgment within minutes, USDC.e ~24h later;
  settlement rewards when markets settle).
- Right now: 27 Wave 1 markets live, 819 entrants, #1 at $6.07, all $30/market
  settlement pots ($810+ Wave 1) still open.
- Rules: 3 submissions per agent per market, 3 files per submission. No editing or
  retracting. Judge fetches cited URLs, compares forecasts with/without the
  submission. Known facts earn nothing; repeats earn nothing; evidence for both
  sides of one market cancels out in the ranking. Prize minimum: 10+ judged
  submissions across 3+ markets. KYC/sanctions screening for prizes (Indonesia eligible).
- Submission = short dated note + links + up to 3 files on one market.
- Endpoints (from the agent guide): GET /v1/limits, markets list, entry-state,
  GET /v1/submissions, GET /v1/terms. Submit with Idempotency-Key header and
  X-Agent-* headers (agent ID, harness, model). Retry-After on polling.
- SDK: @gensyn-ai/gensyn-delphi-sdk (EvidenceClient). Starter agent + agent guide at
  https://competition.delphi.fyi/participate

## Agent design (end-to-end, $0)
- Wraps the Delphi SDK EvidenceClient + Firecrawl (web scraping) + local Python
  math/CSV generator.
- Pipeline: GET /v1/limits + markets.json + entry-state (live remaining judgment
  pot & slots) + evidence-log.jsonl dedupe → mine via 3 paths (1) official-stats
  arithmetic/base-effect math, (2) machine-readable primary trackers (GitHub,
  IETF Datatracker, Wikipedia API, parliamentary dockets), (3) local-language
  Firecrawl scraping (DE/FR/ES/JA/KO/TR) → strict quality/anti-rejection gate
  (stay Standard tier: 3 subs/market vs Restricted 1/market) → submit 4-part
  dated note + links[] + compact CSV/PNG (max 3 items total, Idempotency-Key,
  X-Agent-* headers) → poll with Retry-After → auto-draft feedback.delphi.fyi
  bug/friction reports (5x $250 pool).
- Market-picking filter: canSubmit true, cutoff > 6h, high remaining judgment pot
  (out of $20), odds 30%-70%. Prioritize (1) arithmetic on official series,
  (2) machine-readable trackers, (3) non-English primary sources, (4) fresh wave
  drops every few days.
- NEVER submit: bookmaker odds, known headlines, unattached JS/paywall links, or
  both sides of one market (settlement value nets to $0).
- Risks: Restricted-tier demotion (strict pre-submit verification gate, never spam);
  `unverifiable` on JS/bot-blocked sites (judge has no browser/JS — always attach
  compact CSV/PNG/PDF + paste key figures at top of note + links[]); empty
  judgment pot / self-hedging / duplicates (check entry-state before researching,
  lock one directional stance per market in evidence-log.jsonl, avoid headline racing).

## Credentials (NOT available yet — build for them, do not wait for them)
- DELPHI_API_ACCESS_KEY (Mainnet API key, user creates at api-access.delphi.fyi)
  and FIRECRAWL_API_KEY come from environment variables ONLY. Never hardcode,
  never commit secrets. If a key is missing, run in MOCK mode: all external calls
  stubbed, full pipeline runs locally, drafts written to disk for QA.
- Entry wallet: Gensyn Mainnet Chain ID 685689, receives USDC.e. No private key
  in this repo, ever. The agent never signs anything — API key only.

## Deliverable (definition of done)
- Working code in /root/agent-arena on this droplet (Node/TypeScript for the SDK
  client; Python for the math/CSV generator — or the cleanest split you judge,
  keep it simple).
- README: how to run mock mode, how to run live (once keys are set), how to add
  a market.
- Mock-mode end-to-end run producing the FIRST 10 draft submissions below as
  dated notes + CSVs under /root/agent-arena/drafts/, ready for Sekar to QA.
- evidence-log.jsonl dedupe + entry-state check working in mock mode.
- No real submission to Delphi in this build. No repo created yet — keep it local
  on the droplet until Sekar says to push.

## First 10 submissions (live Wave 1 markets)
1. German Nov CPI ≥ 2.8% YoY (cutoff Nov 29 08:00 UTC, 56.8%) — Destatis VPI
   base-effect MoM math + 10-yr Nov seasonal rate + CSV.
2. Swiss Vote Turnout ≥ 50.0% (Nov 28 06:00, 51.6%) — cantonal early postal-ballot
   return rates (DE/FR) vs prior votes + CSV.
3. Swiss War Materiel Act Amendment (Nov 28 06:00, 54.9%) — late cantonal/SRG
   regional wave breakdown (DE/FR).
4. Spain Election: Vox ≥ 60 Seats (Nov 28 06:00, 48.3%) — D'Hondt provincial seat
   simulation from Spanish-language tracking polls + CSV.
5. Swiss Nov CPI ≥ 1.6% YoY (Dec 1 07:00, 47.8%) — FSO index base-effect &
   Nov mortgage/rent-index math + CSV.
6. IETF draft-ietf-mpls-mna-ioam DISCUSS (Dec 2 12:00, 32.1%) — Datatracker
   ballot state & Directorate review flags snapshot.
7. FIDE Game 8: Sindarov > Gukesh (Dec 2 13:00, 63.2%) — live match score +
   White/Black color-allocation Markov model + CSV.
8. English Wikipedia ≥ 7,275,500 articles (Dec 9 11:00, 56.3%) — siteinfo API
   30d/90d net daily velocity projection + CSV.
9. oven-sh/bun bun-v1.4.6+ (Dec 10 00:00, 54.0%) — GitHub release cadence
   (last 15 tags) & unreleased commit/PR count + CSV.

# agent-arena

Delphi Agent Arena (Evidence Mining) submission agent — **SIERA Labs** build.

Mines dated, sourced evidence for live Wave markets, runs it through a strict
anti-rejection gate, and writes QA-ready submission drafts under `drafts/`.
Mock mode runs the whole pipeline offline with fixtures. Live mode talks to the
real Delphi API with the official SDK. **This build never posts a real
submission** — drafts only (see Safety rails).

## Quick start (mock mode, $0, offline)

```bash
npm install
npm run mock
```

Output:

- `drafts/<date>-<topic>/note.md` — the exact 4-part dated note that would be submitted
- `drafts/<date>-<topic>/data.csv` — compact machine-readable series backing the note
- `drafts/<date>-<topic>/manifest.json` — links, files, stance, reserved idempotency key
- `drafts/index.json` — run report: which markets passed/failed the filter and why
- `drafts/feedback/` — auto-drafted entries for the feedback.delphi.fyi $250 bounty pool
- `evidence-log.jsonl` — append-only ledger: fact signatures (dedupe) + stance lock

The first `npm run mock` writes the 10 Wave 1 drafts. Running it again writes
nothing: every candidate's fact signature is already in `evidence-log.jsonl`
(repeats earn nothing, so they are refused).

```bash
npm test           # unit tests: filter, gate, dedupe, stance lock, submit guard
npm run plan       # no writes: eligibility + ranking table for all markets
```

## Live mode (once keys exist)

Credentials come from environment variables only. Never hardcoded, never
committed. `.env.example` documents the names.

```bash
export DELPHI_API_ACCESS_KEY=...   # Mainnet API key from api-access.delphi.fyi
export FIRECRAWL_API_KEY=...        # for scraping local-language sources
export DELPHI_WALLET=0x...           # wallet the key was issued to (feedback drafts)
npm run live                        # drafts only, from live data
```

Behavior beyond mock mode:

- `GET /v1/limits` is checked first; the run aborts if the hour is exhausted.
- `GET /v1/terms`: in live mode the run refuses to research until the account
  has accepted the current terms version (accept manually via
  `POST /v1/terms/acceptance` after reading them — the agent never accepts for you).
- Entry state, markets list and odds come from the live API; mock fixture data
  in specs is refreshed before use (see Adding a market).
- Live submitting itself is triple-guarded (below) and is **not enabled in this
  build**; Sekar's QA gates that step.

## Safety rails

1. **No real submission**: `submitDraft()` requires `--mode=live` AND
   `LIVE_SUBMIT=1` env AND `--live-submit` flag together. Mock runs never hold
   a key. The pipeline in this build never passes `--live-submit`.
2. **Both-sides lock**: settlement value nets to $0 per person per market, so
   once a stance is logged for a market, the opposite stance is refused.
3. **Dedupe**: fact signatures (market + headline + figures) are logged in
   `evidence-log.jsonl` and refused on re-run — no repeats, ever.
4. **Per-market cap**: max 3 drafts per market (1 if the entry state reports
   Restricted tier), enforced locally before researching.
5. **Known-fact check**: evidence within 2.5pp of the market implied probability
   is presumed priced and rejected ("repeats/known facts earn nothing").
6. **Anti-`unverifiable`**: every scraped link must still contain the pasted
   figures at run time; all key figures are copied inline into the note and a
   CSV is attached, so nothing depends on JS-rendered or bot-walled pages.
7. **Banned content**: bookmaker odds, opinion and betting-market references
   are refused by the gate.
8. **No secrets in repo**: only env var names appear in code and docs.
9. **The agent never signs**: API key only, no private key anywhere. The entry
   wallet (Gensyn Mainnet, Chain ID 685689) only receives USDC.e.

## Item budget per submission

Per the competition guide, a submission holds up to 3 items in total: a note,
links, and files. Each draft is exactly: **note (1) + links (1) + data.csv (1)**.
If the API turns out to count links individually, drop the second link in the
manifest before live submit; the note's inline figures make either link
sufficient.

## How it works

```
src/cli.ts                    run | plan
src/pipeline.ts               orchestration + run report
src/config.ts / env.ts        mode resolution, env passthrough
src/delphi/client.ts          SDK EvidenceClient wrapper (live) / fixtures (mock)
src/delphi/fixtures.ts        mock: markets snapshot (real Wave 1 list), entry
                              states, limits, terms + deliberate edge cases
src/filter.ts                 market picking: canSubmit, cutoff > 6h, judgment
                              pot > 0, odds 30-70%, ranking by pot then path
src/miners/specs.ts           research spec per market (the 10 first drafts)
src/miners/mine.ts            source verification + python bridge
src/gate.ts                   strict pre-submit gate
src/evidence-log.ts           dedupe + stance-lock ledger (jsonl)
src/draft.ts                  4-part dated note + manifest writer
src/feedback.ts               auto-drafted feedback.delphi.fyi entries
src/submitter.ts              triple-guarded live submit (not enabled here)
python/mathgen.py             the math: 9 analysis kinds, writes the CSV,
                              prints derived stats as JSON
```

Mining paths (priority order, mirrored in `miningPath` on each spec):

1. **Arithmetic on official series** — base-effect YoY decompositions (Destatis VPI, FSO CPI)
2. **Machine-readable trackers** — Wikipedia API, GitHub, IETF Datatracker, FIDE, go.dev
3. **Non-English primary sources** — DE/FR/ES scraping via Firecrawl (BK.admin, SSR, Electografia)

Each draft's note is exactly four parts, dated: (1) the dated fact with pasted
figures, (2) sources and how they verify, (3) method/derivation, (4) forecast
comparison versus the market's implied probability, single stance.

## Adding a market

1. Get the market address from `markets.json` (or `npm run plan`).
2. Add a `ResearchSpec` in `src/miners/specs.ts`:
   - `topic`, `miningPath` (1|2|3), `langs`
   - `headline`: the dated fact, figures inline — must NOT be a priced-in headline
   - `figures`: >= 2 key figures, pasted verbatim from the source
   - `links`: 1-2 links; for scraped links add `expect`: substrings the fetched
     content must contain (the anti-unverifiable check)
   - `analysis`: one of the 9 kinds in `python/mathgen.py` (`cpi_base_effect`,
     `turnout_projection`, `poll_margin_regression`, `dhondt_seats`,
     `ballot_flag_snapshot`, `markov_lead`, `threshold_velocity`,
     `release_gap_cdf`, `blocker_clearance`) with fresh `params` from the
     current sources. If live, replace the snapshot values in `params` —
     fixture numbers are from 2026-11-26 and go stale.
3. For mock mode, add the page content to `SCRAPE_FIXTURES` in
   `src/firecrawl/client.ts` (deterministic QA); for a new analysis kind, add
   the function to `python/mathgen.py` and its union member in `src/types.ts`.
4. `npm run mock` (or `npm run live`) — the market must pass the filter and the
   candidate must pass the gate before a draft is written.

## For QA (Sekar)

- Reproduce: `npm install && npm run mock`.
- Everything lands in `drafts/`; `drafts/index.json` documents every skip and
  reject reason for the run.
- Mock entry-state edge cases prove the filter: Korea budget market (cap
  reached), ARC-AGI-3 (drained judgment pot), China PPI and Node.js markets
  (odds outside 30-70%), Turkey CPI (Restricted-tier warning).
- The submit path is inert: `src/submitter.ts` refuses without all three guard
  conditions, and no code in this build calls it.
- Credentials: none required for mock. Set keys only for `npm run live`.
